Manual screen-reader and native permission-dialog checks remain outside this evidence.

responsive.evidence: Inspected actual page-menu renders at all three targets. The card fits the visual viewport, stacks fields when narrow and passes 150% visual-viewport zoom, forced colors and reduced transparency. Transparent curved-corner pixels show the host page and hit testing reaches it; native popup view count is zero.

success.evidence: Actual trusted activation creates image controls and closes the menu. Reopening detects the same enabled document; disable/allow retains explicit reactivation. Actual OCR/NLLB overlay regression passes separately.
